items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: The only way like that was Don Alpert had a job. I don't know. every night on the road somewhere

ctx.x: When he was, that's, that's, that's, I don't like to ask you about that. Well, I mean, it must have, it must have been. I couldn't.
Unless he was in and had a standing job. The only way like that was Don Alpert had a job. I don't know.
every night on the road somewhere and he'd get back tired enough to go to sleep and go to work in a day. Maybe he had a job in Texas somewhere. You see?
